onboarding.title: A quiet moment for yourself
onboarding.intro: Explore yourself through Tarot and Zodiac. No account needed — you can begin even when you are offline.
onboarding.chooseBody: Pick a Tarot spread, or visit Zodiac to learn about your sign.
onboarding.drawBody: Take a moment to reflect on what is on your mind, then draw. In 3 Card Spread, tap each card to reveal it or choose Reveal All.
onboarding.readBody: Tap a revealed card to explore its meaning. In Yearly Tarot, swipe sideways to discover all 5 aspects.
onboarding.tip: Not sure where to start? Try Card of the Day — one card to accompany you throughout the day.
onboarding.note: These readings are for reflection and reference.

zodiacHome.subtitle: Choose your cosmic path
zodiacHome.originDescription: Discover the stories behind the 12 signs

settings.subtitle: Make this space your own
settings.languageDescription: Choose your interface language. Changes apply immediately and are saved on this device.
settings.translationDescription: Menus, 78 Tarot cards, 12 zodiac profiles and Day / Week / Year readings support English and Vietnamese. Text embedded in artwork remains in English. These readings are for reflection and entertainment.
settings.offline: Your language preference works offline. No account required.

adsQa.devOnly: This screen is available only when development mode is enabled.
adsQa.androidNote: The browser shows layout previews only. Install the debug APK to load native test ads.
adsQa.testNotice: Safe Google demo ad units are active. Only interact with ads marked Test Ad.

adsQa.rewardedDescription: Tests rewarded and skipped callbacks using a demo video.
